text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having safely claimed victory in the Queen Stakes, Yukino Bijin throws herself into training with even more determination.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Trainer? Do y'think we could go a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I know you're try'n to keep me safe, but I can't just kick my feet up and do noth'n!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: While I understand how she feels, she's already been working so hard. If she pushes herself any more, she may injure herself from overexertion.
Is that a troubled soul I hear over there?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O! Hello there!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O is in the year above Yukino Bijin and has been making a name for herself as a sprinter.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Thanks again for help'n me out the other day!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Well, I was try'n t'use the self-checkout at the convenience store…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: But I didn't realize it didn't take cash! Then, I saw there were all these people b'hind me so I started panick'n!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: And that's when I, class rep extraordinaire, swooped in, raised my hand up high… and called over a member of staff for help!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You really saved my bacon!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O's been real kind t'me since my very first day at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um… It feels a bit weird t'say, but you kinda remind me of my dad. Talk'n to you puts me at ease!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The compassion of a class rep knows no bounds!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In any case, I have to thank you too! I owe you one!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yes! Remember how you carried me to the infirmary after I over-Bakushined during a long-distance race and couldn't move?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Aw, shucks! That was noth'n! Carry'n you was a lot easier than having t'haul out a tractor stuck in the field.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two seem to have built a solid friendship through mutual support.
choice_data_list: What was it you were saying when you came over?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah! I almost forgot!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Yukino looked like she was in a spot of trouble, so I thought I'd come over to lend my help as class rep!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Good golly! Thanks oodles, Bakushin O! The thing is…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: I see! You want some training that won't fatigue you…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: In that case, how about playing some kind of game?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Depending on the game, this could be a great form of exercise. It's not as effective as normal training, but it shouldn't wear her out, which is perfect for our situation.
choice_data_list: You're not class rep for nothing!
You're not class rep for nothing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's right! Don't you worry about a thing! I know plenty of games you can play!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I'd love to hear 'em!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let me see…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: There's "Bakushin or Power," or maybe… "Bakushin Inferno"!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Wowzers, those names just scream hardcore!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …Too hardcore if you ask me. But I must admit I'm curious, so I decide to pick one for now. I can always stop them if it's too extreme.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Nice choice! The word "power" just has a nice ring to it, doesn't it? Let's get straight to it!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ready? It's time for… Bakushin or Power!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um… y-yay?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: The rules are super simple! If the judge says "Bakushin," you've gotta strike a Bakushin pose, and if they say "power," you've gotta strike a power pose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: As for the pose, anything goes! Presentation complete!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: That's it!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Um… Is this really train'n?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Why don't you be the judge, Trainer! Go ahead and decide what pose we should do!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Not sure I'm gett'n it, but let's give it a go! When you're ready, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Go ahead and kick things off with a Bakushin! Now leeet's go!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: … Today, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Bakushiiin!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Bakushin-shiiin!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Ba…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Er!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Hey! Did you hear that, ref?!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoopsie doodle! So much for try'n t'pull the wool over your eyes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the end, I still can't tell if this counts as actual training… or if it even qualifies as a game. But the two of them look like they're having fun, so I keep my thoughts to myself.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Oho! Someone's fired up! Not even that scary name was enough to daunt you, I see!
choice_data_list: Just making sure, but this game isn't dangerous, is it?
Just making sure, but this game isn't dangerous, is it?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course not! As class rep, I would never put any student in danger!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Your mouth, on the other hand, might be in for a spicy surprise!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Right, then! Let's dive headfirst into the inferno!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: B-Bakushin, is this…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: It is! It's time to brave the hottest of foods in the hottest of temperatures! Welcome to the Inferno—the ultimate test of grit!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: O-okay…

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I just wanna double-check, but is this really considered train'n?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Of course! This is training to toughen you up!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: There are a million of ways to grow stronger! Believe in your class rep, and you won't be led astray!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Okey doke! Lead the way!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: All right, whoever finishes everything wins! Let's tuck in!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Here goes noth'n!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff…

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Even the steam BUUURNS!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Blow, blow… Jeepers. I can't even get close enough t'take a bite!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Is this training incredible or what?!
choice_data_list: (It sure doesn't look like training to me…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still, Yukino Bijin is trying really hard to complete the challenge. She's already done enough real training for today, so I decide to stay quiet.
